Dr. Soroush Khoshroo is a chiropractor practicing in North Vancouver, Canada. He has been in practice since 2011. He's the owner and director of QubeCore Sports & Rehab, a multi-disciplinary clinic in North Vancouver. 

CLINICAL FOCUS: 
- Active Release Technique (ART)
- Shockwave Therapy
- Graston Technique
- Custom orthotics
- Sports injuries
- Pregnancy pain
- MVA & whiplash injuries
- Kinesio taping
- Rehab exercises

EDUCATION:
- Bachelor of Science in Cell Biology and Genetics – University of British Columbia, Vancouver, B.C.
- Doctor of Chiropractic – University of Western States, Portland, Oregon

WEBSITE & INFO:
- www.qubecore.com
- 604.210.2274

BOOKING: 
https://qubecore.janeapp.com

QubeCore Sports & Rehab

North Vancouver, BC, Canada
